verses.pali: “Pañcahi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu yathābhataṁ nikkhitto evaṁ niraye.
verses.english: “Mendicants, a monk with five qualities is placed in hell as if delivered there.

verses.pali: Pāṇātipātī hoti, adinnādāyī hoti, abrahmacārī hoti, musāvādī hoti, surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhāyī hoti.
verses.english: He kills living creatures, steals, has sex, lies, and consumes beer, wine, and liquor intoxicants.

verses.pali: Imehi kho, bhikkhave, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu yathābhataṁ nikkhitto evaṁ niraye.
verses.english: A monk with these five qualities is placed in hell as if delivered there.

verses.pali: Pañcahi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu yathābhataṁ nikkhitto evaṁ sagge.
verses.english: A monk with five qualities is placed in heaven as if delivered there.

verses.pali: Pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti, adinnādānā paṭivirato hoti, abrahmacariyā paṭivirato hoti, musāvādā paṭivirato hoti, surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānā paṭivirato hoti.
verses.english: He doesn’t kill living creatures, steal, have sex, lie, or consume beer, wine, and liquor intoxicants.

verses.pali: Imehi kho, bhikkhave, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu yathābhataṁ nikkhitto evaṁ sagge”ti.
verses.english: A monk with these five qualities is placed in heaven as if delivered there.”
